result.topic_en: Gauss tabulates, for 25 lines of his 1824 Hanoverian triangulation, the curvature (arc) angle, the sum of the zenith distances minus 180°, the resulting refraction, and the refraction coefficient, then derives the mean refraction ratio and its mean error.
